This '''unidentified [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]]''' male was a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], who served the [[One Sith]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In the aftermath of the [[Battle on Had Abbadon]], the acolyte was looking after [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Hand (One Sith)|Hands]], [[Darth Stryfe]] and [[Darth Talon]], who were being healed in [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] [[Bacta tank/Legends|tanks]] located in the [[Healing Chambers]] of the [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[XoXaan's Temple|Sith Temple]]. He witnessed [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] Stryfe breaking out of the tank when the latter became aware that he no longer [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] the constant presence of Darth Krayt through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Stryfe wrathfully grabbed the acolyte by the robe, demanding to know where Krayt was. In answer, the terrified acolyte pointed in the direction of the [[Darth Krayt's tomb|chamber]] holding the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] in stasis.
